INFO.TITLE: About This Calculator
INFO.DESCRIPTION:
Hi there 👋!

I really enjoy making pizza, but there’s always one annoying part: doing all the calculations for the dough proportions. That’s why I created this app — to make those calculations easy and help people focus on what really matters: making great pizza.

Built with ❤️ by {{author}}.
